title: Release notes — Cursor Cost Tracker (1.0.5)
intro: Model pricing on Statistics, Support write-a-message, GitHub Pages landing site, and docs/site comparison table refresh.

sections.name: New features
items: **Model pricing** — Statistics table from the public Cursor pricing docs (request counts from Last N, CursorBench score). Toolbar opens the official models page.
**Support → Write a message** — Comment / feature / bug / other to the author (FormSubmit). Nickname and email from the Cursor account; publish consent for comments.
**Landing page** — `site/` for GitHub Pages after deploy from main.

sections.name: Improvements / Fixes
items: **Panel** — six tabs: Last N, Statistics, Charts, Optimize, Support, Settings.
**Pace / forecast** — Pace card and forecast bars use good/warn colors vs the month plan.

sections.name: Notes
items: Pricing fetch is public docs markdown; Support mail does not include the session token.
Only blocking modal remains the last-query critical alert.
